component.name: PolarExp
component.summary: A focused local file explorer with Vim-style controls

description.p: PolarExp is a Linux file explorer for local work. It combines conventional mouse and keyboard selection with a compact Vim-style browser grammar.
It supports desktop clipboard and drag-and-drop transfers, safe conflict handling, persistent undo, search, Trash, Recent, mounted volumes, and file metadata actions.
Initial preview packaging for the complete PolarExp 1.0 workflow.
